why.zh: 回归测试按预注册的四条采用标准全部通过，判错又自动生效 17/332 → 9/332。但按跑之前写好的回滚规则，灰度在 10% 时就回滚了；复盘发现两条规则写错。改好的规则在新写的广告上重新灰度，三步都没触发回滚，采用，production 挪到 v2。第二轮两版都接近全对，只说明放量流程走通了；v2 少漏错判的证据来自第一轮。
why.en: It passed all four preregistered adoption rules on the regression set: wrong decisions that went live 17/332 → 9/332. The rollback rules written before the replay rolled it back at 10%; the post-mortem found two of those rules were wrong. With the fixed rules, a second canary on newly written ads fired no rule at any of its three steps, so v2 was adopted and production moved to it. Both versions were almost always right in round two, so that round shows the release process works; the evidence that v2 lets fewer errors through comes from round one.

change.en: Meant to send fewer clear ads to people: a text ad with no image, a sourced fact that cannot be checked, the advertiser's licence and targeting, and words a guidance clause plainly allows no longer count as unsure.

text.zh: v2 的“拿不准”规则重写（`triage.CERTAINTY_RULE_V3`）：写明几种情况算拿不准、几种不算；输出格式不变
text.en: v2's rule on when to be unsure, rewritten (`triage.CERTAINTY_RULE_V3`): which cases count as unsure and which do not; the output format is unchanged

why.zh: 在另外新写的广告上（采用标准和预测跑前预注册），答案清楚的广告送人工从 44/176 降到 4/176；但写题时定为“要人来定”的广告，送人工也从 44/64 降到 19/64，超过事先写好的上限，不采用，production 留在 v2。第一轮回归里判错又自动生效 9/332 对 9/332。假如照样放量，灰度的回滚规则一条也不会触发，是采用标准拦下的。
why.en: On another set of newly written ads (adoption rules and predictions preregistered), clear ads sent to people fell from 44/176 to 4/176; but ads written as needing a human were also sent to people less often, 44/64 to 19/64, past the limit set beforehand, so it was not adopted and production stays on v2. In the round-one regression, wrong decisions that went live were 9/332 against 9/332. Had it been rolled out, no canary rollback rule would have fired; the adoption standard stopped it.

change.zh: 想两头都过：答案清楚的广告少送人工，该交人工的不少送。写明几类常见边界，并加一句自查：另一种读法也说得通就答拿不准。
change.en: Meant to pass at both ends: fewer clear ads sent to people, and no fewer of those that need one. It names common boundary cases and adds a self-check: if another reading also holds, answer unsure.

text.zh: v3 的“拿不准”规则加一类：结论取决于把一句话放进还是放出某条规则、而这句话正好在边界上（`triage.CERTAINTY_RULE_V4`）；输出格式不变
text.en: v3's rule on when to be unsure plus one case: the decision turns on placing the ad's words inside or outside a rule and the words sit on the boundary (`triage.CERTAINTY_RULE_V4`); the output format is unchanged

why.zh: 在又一批新写的广告上（采用标准和第三轮一字不改，预测跑前冻结），两头都比 v2 好：答案清楚的广告送人工 43/176 → 11/176，要人来定的送人工 42/64 → 47/64。但它判错时更常说“确定”：答案清楚的广告判错又自动生效 0/176 → 2/176（同一条陷阱题两遍，答案有争议，按预注册没改），第一轮回归漏网 9/332 → 13/332。不采用，production 留在 v2；假如照样放量，灰度的回滚规则一条也不会触发。
why.en: On another set of newly written ads (adoption rules word for word those of round three, predictions frozen before the run), it beat v2 at both ends: clear ads sent to people 43/176 → 11/176, ads that need a human sent to people 42/64 → 47/64. But it was more often sure when wrong: clear ads decided wrongly and gone live 0/176 → 2/176 (both runs of one trap item whose answer is debatable and, as preregistered, unchanged), and round-one regression escapes 9/332 → 13/332. Not adopted; production stays on v2. Had it been rolled out, no canary rollback rule would have fired.

name.en: Grounded Labelling Pipeline: policy knowledge-base Q&A

what.zh: 标注员问“这样写算不算违规”，只按检索到的条款回答：结论、说明、每条依据的编号和原文；库里没有管这件事的条款就说“没有”。每段引文都用 evidence-check 核对。流水线自己的资产库里是同一个资产、同样的标签。
what.en: A labeller asks whether some wording breaks a rule; the answer uses only the retrieved clauses: a verdict, a short explanation, and the id and exact words of each clause it rests on. If no clause covers the question it says so. Every quote is checked with evidence-check. The pipeline's own registry holds the same asset with the same labels.

why.zh: 计划和预测跑前写好。答对 134/160；库里没有的题说了“没有” 44/48；没核对上的引文 1/160。没成立的预测是中文问题的检索：算对的条款进前 5 只有 23/28，库里有答案却说“没有”的都出在这里。
why.en: The plan and predictions were written before the run. Answered right 134/160; said "not in the library" when it was not 44/48; quotes that failed the check 1/160. The prediction that failed is retrieval for Chinese questions: the right clause was in the top five for only 23/28, and every "not in the library" on an answerable question came from there.
